name: grok
description: Community-observed Grok knobs from ext-apps#750 (MoonPay Paybox report, 2026-08-19), not vendor documentation. Varies from spec only in what #750 observes: tool-result is not redelivered after state changes (symptom 1, stale UI), duplicate concurrent widget instances occur (symptom 3), embedded signing/passkey surfaces hang so popups stay blocked (symptom 2), and the Claude-scheme _meta.ui.domain is not modelled as enforced.
